scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @phone-party/protocol build && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @phone-party/server dev" "pnpm --filter @phone-party/web dev"
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @phone-party/protocol build && pnpm --filter @phone-party/protocol test && pnpm --filter @phone-party/server test:unit && pnpm --filter @phone-party/web test:unit
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && pnpm exec playwright test -c apps/web/playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
